importSettingsTitle.description: Title of the file dialog that imports a settings file.

exportSettingsTitle.description: Title of the save dialog that exports the settings to a file.

importThemeTitle.description: Title of the file dialog that imports a Monaco editor theme.

jsonFiles.description: File type filter in open and save dialogs.

notJson.description: Error when an imported file can't be parsed. {{file}} is the file name.

notSettings.description: Error when an imported settings file isn't a JSON object. {{file}} is the file name.

notTheme.message: {{file}} isn't a Monaco theme. A theme needs "base" or "rules", with colours as hex values.
notTheme.description: Error when an imported theme file isn't a valid Monaco theme. {{file}} is the file name. Keep "base" and "rules" untranslated.

openFailed.description: Error when the OS can't open a file or folder. {{path}} is the path, {{reason}} the OS message.

themeCopyName.description: Name of a new theme created from the current one. {{name}} is the current theme's name.

lucentDark.description: Name of the built-in dark theme. Lucent is the design system's name; keep it as is.

lucentLight.description: Name of the built-in light theme. Lucent is the design system's name; keep it as is.
